notes.title: Content Update
notes.notes:
This patch adds the highly requested Free camera mode to the game which allows players to move around the map and explore larger levels. Press C or V to switch between camera modes. Use WASD and the mouse to move around in Free camera mode. Furthermore, 3 brand new courses have also been added to the game increasing total hole count to 180.

Important 

You need to reset your settings in order to enable Free camera mode for the first time. This is required because of the keybinding changes.
You'll only be able to play online multiplayer with your friends using the same version (v.1.2.0.0) as you, so don't forget to update your game client.


Changelog 

Added Free camera mode to the game. 
Added 3 new courses (27 holes in total)
Changed default keybindings.
Changed default controller scheme.
V-sync is now turned on by default.
Various level geometry changes.
Minor bug fixes.


Have fun!

-Zol

notes.title: Online Multiplayer Update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30773970/f712bb7370b99587acbbfeb37599ef4a3313e5de.png
The latest patch brings huge improvements to the gameplay and multiplayer experience. Online multiplayer has been redesigned from the ground up adding a new Lobby system, in-game Steam friend list support, connectivity and stability improvements. Check out the full change log below:

Changelog
Gameplay

Removed penalty for out of bounds and water hazard strokes.
Power bar has been improved by expanded length and added markers for more accuracy.
Slightly increased gravity.
Temporarily disabled announcer until production ready sound effects are added.
Improved follow camera smoothing during a shot.
Small fixes on some levels.

Online multiplayer

Online multiplayer has been reworked from the ground up switching from a peer-to-peer network architecture to a server-based one. This update should fix most connectivity issues and provide a much better online experience.
Added redesigned Lobby for online multiplayer game mode.
Added friend list and the ability to join your friend's private match more easily.
You can now give up a hole in the Pause menu during an online multiplayer match for +5 penalty points over par.
Ping is now visible for all players in a multiplayer match.
Stability improvements.

User interface

You can now access online multiplayer features from the main menu instead of the game mode selection menu.
Online region selector has been moved to Settings -> Network menu.
Added Local port selector to the Settings -> Network menu.
Added Vibration level slider to the Settings -> Controls menu to be able to control the vibration strength of your controller.
Small changes and typo fixes on the user interface.


-Zol

notes.title: Hotfix 2
notes.notes:
Changelog:

Added Shot mode option to the Settings -> Controls menu. You can now choose from two modes: Tap & Hold or 2-Taps.
Added Power curve option to the Settings -> Controls menu. You can now choose from two power curves: Linear or Exponential. Use Exponential power curve if you have problem controlling the power of your shots for short distances.
Added advanced post-processing options to the Settings -> Graphics menu to be able to disable Depth of Field and Motion Blur effects.
Multiple level geometry fixes.
Fixed some stability issues.


-Zol

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
I've fixed a handful of critical bugs.

Changelog:

    Added a region selector drop-down menu to the online multiplayer game mode.
    Fixed login bug that affected a couple of players.
    Fixed a multiplayer related issue where players that fell out of the level kept falling indefinitely if Pause menu was visible.
    Fixed various UI related issues.
    Stability improvements.


-Zol
